definitions.explanation: A person who is truthful and sincere. Can be used positively (praising honesty) or with a nuance of being naive or too trusting.

examples.japanese: {彼|かれ}は{正直者|しょうじきもの}だ。
{正直者|しょうじきもの}が{馬鹿|ばか}を{見|み}る{世|よ}の{中|なか}だ。
examples.english: It's a world where honest people end up getting the short end of the stick.

examples.japanese: {昔話|むかしばなし}では{正直者|しょうじきもの}が{最後|さいご}に{幸|しあわ}せになる。
examples.english: In folk tales, the honest person finds happiness in the end.

notes:
USAGE:
The expression {正直者|しょうじきもの}が{馬鹿|ばか}を{見|み}る (honest people get the short end of the stick) is a well-known proverb expressing the idea that being too honest can be disadvantageous. In Japanese folk tales ({昔話|むかしばなし}), the honest character is typically rewarded while the dishonest one is punished.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {正直者|しょうじきもの}が{馬鹿|ばか}を{見|み}る (honesty doesn't pay)
- {正直者|しょうじきもの}は{得|とく}をする (honesty pays off)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {誠実|せいじつ}な{人|ひと}: sincere person — more formal
- {素直|すなお}な{人|ひと}: straightforward, obedient person — emphasizes being receptive and unresisting
